items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: we had Dizzy and Bob Carroll. Bob Carroll was a tenor player. He played tenor and Howard Johnson was the other alto player

ctx.x: Yeah, we had Dizzy and Bob Carroll. Bob Carroll was a tenor player. He played tenor and Howard Johnson was the other alto player, and we had Shad Collins, (Richard) a trumpet player. Bill Dillard and Dizzy. Fullbright was the bass player. John Smith was the guitar player.
This was the band that recorded.
